test_title: PYST 8: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate phrasal verb:
The teacher asked the students to ___ their assignments.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. hand in .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb **"hand in"** means to submit something, such as an assignment or a document, to a person in authority, like a teacher.
 
• In the given sentence, the teacher is instructing students to submit their assignments, so "hand in" is the most appropriate choice.
 
• Other options are incorrect in this context:
 
 
• **"Hand out"** means to distribute items to a group of people.
 
• **"Hand over"** means to give something to someone, often reluctantly or formally.
 
• **"Hand off"** is commonly used in sports or casual contexts to describe passing something to someone else, especially quickly.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The teacher asked the students to **hand in** their assignments.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonly confused phrasal verbs:**
 
 
• **Hand in:** To submit something (e.g., assignments, reports).
 
• **Hand out:** To distribute (e.g., papers, flyers).
 
• **Hand over:** To give control or possession to someone else.
 
• **Hand off:** To pass something quickly to someone else, typically used in sports or informal situations.
